title: My Sports Weekend
text:
My name is Lucas. I like sports very much. On Saturdays I play football with my friends in the park. We play for one hour.

On Sundays I go swimming with my sister. The pool is near my house. I swim fast. After swimming, we eat ice cream together.

questions.text: What sport does Lucas play on Saturdays?
Who does Lucas go swimming with on Sundays?
How do you think Lucas feels about sports?
Why is the pool good for Lucas?

vocabulary.definition: a public green area where people can play and walk
a place with water where people swim
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Lucas. Eu gosto muito de esportes. Aos sábados, eu jogo futebol com meus amigos no parque. Nós jogamos por uma hora.
Aos domingos, eu vou nadar com minha irmã. A piscina fica perto da minha casa. Eu nado rápido. Depois de nadar, nós comemos sorvete juntos.
